newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a buy.

text.p: Brazilian investment bank Fonte Cindam reiterated its buy rating and 180-real target price on federal telecom holding Telebras, citing the firm's first-half financial results.
-- "We judge that the results presented by the company for the first semester are good, a little above our expectation in June," Fonte Cindam telecoms analyst Claudio Nassur said in a report.
-- The company on Friday released a net profit of 1.494 billion reais for the first half of 1997, including a June net profit of 315 million reais.
-- "The most notable aspect of the results was the rise in the average (monthly) net profit from 236 million reais in the first five months to 315 million reais in June," he wrote.
-- June rise was due mostly to a tariff rebalancing and changes in the rates used by Telebras units for remitting long-distance revenues to long-distance carrier Embratel, he said.

-- The rise in revenues Embratel receives has had a positive impact on the results of Telebras, which owns 100 percent of Embratel compared with 80-percent ownership of its state-level operating units, he added.

-- Telebras' ADR was down 3-9/16 at 136-5/8 in New York while its preferred share was off 2.63 percent at 148 reais and its common was off 3.95 percent at 133.99 reais in Sao Paulo at 1154 local/1454 gmt.
